_doc: Hardware-typical raw t/s bands for common models + quant combos. Used by the report to say 'fast for your hardware' / 'typical for this class'. Numbers are conservative medians from published benchmarks and community reports as of Aug 2026. They are NOT a guarantee; they are context. If your number is way above the band, something might be off (smaller model, slot contention helped, missing think-tag overhead). If way below, same the other way. Bands reflect the median task in our 1024-1500 token benchmark.
_note: Update entries as the field moves. Add a new model+hw_class entry rather than overwriting. Tags: hw_class, model_arch, quant, tok_s_lo, tok_s_hi, ref_url

_hw_class_blurbs.phone_laptop: Phones, thin laptops, anything without a discrete GPU. Slower but usable for chat and small tasks.
_hw_class_blurbs.desktop_gpu_mid: Mid-range desktops and laptops with a discrete GPU (e.g. RTX 4060) or M-series Pro chips.
_hw_class_blurbs.desktop_gpu_high: High-end desktops (RTX 4090/5090) or M-series Ultra. Sweet spot for 27B-class quants.
_hw_class_blurbs.workstation: Multi-GPU boxes or pro workstations. Overkill for chat, ideal for batch jobs and 70B+.
_hw_class_blurbs.dataclass: Server-class hardware (H100, DGX Spark). The fastest realistic setup; usually overkill for one user.
